chain: Chain B - Installer Packaging / Package Manifest Validation
realBehaviorProven: buildManifestFromDirectory() recursively discovers every regular file in a real build directory (reusing Batch 4's discoverRegularFiles) and computes a real SHA256 checksum per file, deterministically ordered by relativePath.

validatePackageManifest() rejects a manifest whose knownLimitationsRef/privacyStatementRef/executableRef points at a file not actually present in the inventory (dangling-reference rejection) at BUILD time, not discovered later.
verifyManifestIntegrity() re-hashes every file on disk against the manifest's recorded checksum and rejects both tampering (checksum mismatch) and missing files.
assertMatchesExpected() rejects a manifest built for the wrong productId or version before acceptance proceeds.
buildAcceptanceReceipt() is a deterministic pure function of manifest content (order-independent, no wall-clock) -- proven via a reversed-file-order equality test.

Full lifecycle proven across all 6 real commercial products (library-factory, keyboard-pro, creator, studio-pro, singy-kids, singy-teen): build -> save (Batch 1 AtomicSave) -> reopen -> verify -> receipt.
Realistic batch failure-path proven: 5 products built together, 1 tampered after manifest-build, correctly and independently rejected while the other 4 accept cleanly.
